title: energizer 1.0.0
text: Migrated Get energy performance buildings data API. Added bearer-token authentication epb_set_token() EPB_BEARER_TOKEN. Added certificate retrieval, three certificate search functions, change events, code tables, full-load downloads download metadata new epb_* interface. Added page-based pagination using API pagination response object. Marked legacy odc_* interface defunct Open Data Communities API Basic Authentication workflow obsolete. Removed obsolete Base64 credential encoding, LMK-key retrieval, file listing hard-coded schema archive handling. Fixed HTTP error handling API status response details reported instead secondary NULL response error. Search functions now return empty tibble valid query matching certificates, represented HTTP 404 API. Normalized JSON null record fields row binding avoid repetitive data.table::rbindlist() missing-value warnings.

title: energizer 0.10.0
text: odc_set_key sets Open Data Communities API base64-encoding user-provided credentials. odc_get_data retrieves certificates recommendations domestic, non_domestic display certification types lmk_key attribute. odc_search_data allows users search certificates recommendations domestic, non_domestic display based multiple filtering criteria. odc_get_schema allow retrieval dataset schemas. odc_get_meta returns API metadata, latestDate updateData. odc_bulk_download can used bulk download available files, can retrieved either via odc_get_file_list() odc_get_list().
